description: Security hardening: Add password-based authentication, fix URL-param login vulnerability, add input sanitization, rate limiting for AI calls, and secure API key handling
steps: In database.py: Add a password_hash column to the users table (use hashlib+secrets for hashing since bcrypt is not in deps). Add functions: create_user(username, password) -> int, verify_user(username, password) -> Optional[int], user_exists(username) -> bool. Use parameterized queries (already done, but verify all paths).

In app.py Section 4 (auto-login): Remove the insecure URL ?user= auto-login that lets anyone access any account by typing a username. Replace with session-token-based persistence using st.session_state only (no URL params for auth).

In app.py sidebar login: Replace the simple name-entry with a proper login/register form. Add 'Login' and 'Register' tabs. Registration requires username + password (min 6 chars). Login verifies password hash. Show appropriate error messages.

In app.py: Add a rate limiter for AI calls. Track call timestamps in session_state. Limit to 20 AI calls per 10 minutes. Show a friendly message when limit is hit: 'Take a breather - you have hit the limit for AI requests. Try again in a few minutes.'
In app.py Settings page (tab_ai): Never display the API key in any form (remove the masked display showing first 8 chars). Only show 'Key is set' or 'No key configured'.
In database.py: Add migrate_db() function that safely adds password_hash column to existing users table if it does not exist (ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pattern for SQLite). Call it from init_db().

In app.py: Sanitize all user text inputs (username, chat messages, journal entries) by stripping HTML tags before storage to prevent XSS if content is ever rendered unsafely. Add a simple _sanitize_input(text) helper that strips <script>, <iframe>, and event handler attributes.
acceptance_criteria: Users must register with a username and password to access the app
Existing URL ?user= parameter no longer grants access without authentication
API key is never partially displayed in the UI
AI calls are rate-limited to prevent abuse
All user inputs are sanitized before database storage
All modules import without errors after changes
verification: Run python -m py_compile app.py && python -m py_compile database.py to verify no syntax errors

Run python -c "from database import init_db, create_user, verify_user; init_db(); uid = create_user('testuser', 'pass123'); assert verify_user('testuser', 'pass123') == uid; assert verify_user('testuser', 'wrong') is None; print('Auth OK')"
Run python -c "import app; print('app.py imports cleanly')"
